verse.verse_1: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))?
verse.verse_2: And removed from you your burden,
verse.verse_5: So verily, with the hardship, there is relief,
verse.verse_6: Verily, with the hardship, there is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).
verse.verse_7: So when you have finished (from your occupation), then stand up for Allah's worship (i.e. stand up for prayer).
verse.verse_8: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your intentions and hopes and) your invocations.
